standard_prerequisites.name: A locally finitely presented flat morphism is open

standard_prerequisites.use: Gives that the image of a generic point of an irreducible component is the generic point of the target, which is the first step of the computation.

standard_prerequisites.name: Dimension of a fibre at a point and the transcendence degree formula
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Morphisms, label morphisms-lemma-dimension-fibre-at-a-point, invoked at proof line 2159
standard_prerequisites.use: Converts the vanishing of the dimension of the local ring at the generic point into the statement that the transcendence degree of its residue field over that of the target is the relative dimension r.

core_obligations: Reduce to the final statement: replace the target by the integral closed subscheme and the source by its scheme theoretic inverse image, so that the target is integral and the morphism is flat of relative dimension r (proof lines 2142-2146).

Use that a locally finite type flat morphism over a locally Noetherian target is locally of finite presentation, hence open, so that a generic point of an irreducible component of the source maps to the generic point of the target (proof lines 2147-2154).

Compute the dimension: the fibre over that generic point has dimension r at the point by hypothesis, while the local ring at the generic point of the source has dimension zero because it has a unique prime, so the transcendence degree formula gives the desired equality (proof lines 2154-2162).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to an integral target and the inverse image (proof lines 2142-2146).
Openness of the morphism puts the generic point over the generic point (proof lines 2147-2154).
Transcendence degree computation at the generic point (proof lines 2154-2162).
difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the dimension of the inverse image of a closed subset under a flat morphism of relative dimension r as the dimension of the subset plus r, and shows that an irreducible component of such an inverse image dominates the subset with the same dimension shift (statement lines 2126-2140, tag 02R8). The proof reduces to an integral target with the source replaced by the inverse image, uses that the morphism becomes locally of finite presentation hence open over a locally Noetherian target so that a generic point of an irreducible component maps to the generic point, and then computes the transcendence degree from the dimension of the fibre and the dimension zero local ring. That computation is the substance, so the claim is H2.
